sn47.23:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca ānando āyasmā ca bhaddo pāṭaliputte viharanti kukkuṭārāme.
sn47.23:1.2: atha kho āyasmā bhaddo sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi
sn47.23:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā bhaddo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
sn47.23:1.4: ko nu kho āvuso ānanda hetu ko paccayo yena saddhammaparihānaṃ hoti.
sn47.23:1.5: ko nu kho āvuso ānanda hetu ko paccayo yena saddhammaaparihānaṃ hotīti.
sn47.23:2.2: bhaddako kho te āvuso bhadda ummaggo bhaddakaṃ paṭibhāṇaṃ kalyāṇī paripucchā.
sn47.23:2.4: ko nu kho āvuso ānanda hetu ko paccayo yena saddhammaparihānaṃ hoti.
sn47.23:2.5: ko panāvuso ānanda hetu ko paccayo yena saddhammaaparihānaṃ hotīti.
sn47.23:2.7: catunnaṃ kho āvuso satipaṭṭhānānaṃ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā saddhammaparihānaṃ hoti.
sn47.23:2.8: catunnaṃ ca kho āvuso satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā saddhammaaparihānaṃ hoti.
sn47.23:3.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.23:3.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.23:3.6: imesaṃ kho āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā saddhammaparihānaṃ hoti.
sn47.23:3.7: imesaṃ ca kho āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā saddhammaaparihānaṃ hotīti.
